appraisal_events.evidence: on jugeait généralement l'esprit d'initiative et la supériorité intellectuelle de cette dame d'après une innovation qu'on ne rencontrait nulle part ailleurs dans ce milieu
appraisal_events.explanation: Society generally credits the princess with exceptional social intelligence and inventiveness for her distinctive way of circulating among her guests.

appraisal_events.evidence: elle n'avait à leur parler de rien... elle se contentait... de remercier en disant : « C'est gentil d'être venu », non qu'elle trouvât que l'invité eût fait preuve de gentillesse en venant, mais pour accroître encore la sienne
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator directly exposes the princess's practiced warmth toward arriving guests as a calculated performance for her own social credit rather than genuine interest in them.

status_effects.explanation: General social opinion elevates her as unusually intelligent and original in how she manages her reception.
The narrator's exposure of her insincere, self-serving courtesy undercuts the sympathetic impression created by her reputed graciousness.

ambiguities: The phrase 'l'huissier ... de Mme de Guermantes' momentarily echoes the duchesse de Guermantes's name, but the same usher is called 'l'huissier de la princesse' just before, so this is read as referring to the princesse de Guermantes-Bavière hosting the soirée rather than an appearance of the duchesse; she was not scored.

Le duc de Guermantes's affected slight against the princess's salon ('un rien de Courvoisier') is noted but not scored as an independent event, since the text presents it as subordinate to and outweighed by the general esteem in which she is held ('malgré tout... on jugeait généralement...').

The candidate 'le peintre' most plausibly resolves to M. Detaille, named explicitly in the text as the painter the princess uses to compliment a guest; his role is purely instrumental to illustrating her social technique and the passage gives him no distinct local evaluative outcome of his own, so he was not scored.
